title: Structured Utterance Producer qualification and repository admission
summary: Structured Utterance Producer v0.2-dev2 is the current source candidate for the pre-flattening Structured Utterance seam. It preserves the v0.1 API and v0.2 domain-payload contract, fixes eager boolean nil/type guards introduced in dev1, and awaits independent exact-r13196 qualification because Autobuilder is offline.
invariants: FLATTENED_REPLY_INSUFFICIENT is a successful fail-closed result.
The producer reuses native Structured Utterance semantic objects and does not create a parallel taxonomy.
AI/provider invocation, application authority, effect evaluation and execution remain outside the producer.
A qualified standalone artifact is not portfolio-owned until repository/registry admission succeeds.
Repository admission metadata must not silently change runtime semantics.
The two-commit transport keeps package tree in the parent commit and ready.json as the final commit; the submission branch is immutable after ready.
Nil/type fail-closed checks must be sequential; boolean | or & must not be assumed to short-circuit before an object message.
v0.2-dev1 is superseded before qualification and must not be cited as the current candidate.
procedure: Use packages/structured_utterance_producer_v0.2-dev2 as the current source candidate.
Independent exact-r13196 qualification is tracked by Rasen Falcon request REQ-00002161.
Do not claim Autobuild acceptance or a receipt while Autobuilder is offline.
On PASS, record the exact transcript/commit as executable qualification evidence without changing Structured Response common-envelope ownership.

provenance.claim: Standalone producer boundary, fail-closed flattened reply semantics and ownership limits.
Portfolio review records Structured Utterance Producer as pre-flattening intent/lineage closure with owning artifact still to be added to the registry.
dev2 replaces eager nil/type boolean guards with sequential checks and preserves API structured.utterance.producer/0.1.
